pins.name: AIN2/GPIO2
pins.notes: Channel 2; analog input (default) or GPIO. All channels are analog inputs at power-up or reset (p13). GPIO levels referenced to AVDD (p5).

pins.name: AVDD
pins.notes: Analog supply input, also the ADC reference; 1 uF decoupling capacitor to GND. Power-cycling AVDD resets the device (p18).

pins.name: DECAP
pins.notes: Internal supply; connect a 1 uF decoupling capacitor between DECAP and GND. Also the upper end of the optional ADDR resistor R1.

pins.name: GND
pins.notes: Ground for the power supply; all analog and digital signals are referred to this pin.

pins.name: DVDD
pins.notes: Digital I/O supply voltage; 1 uF decoupling capacitor to GND.

pins.name: ADDR
pins.notes: I2C address select: resistor from DECAP (R1) or to GND (R2), read at power-up; both not populated gives 0x10 (Table 2, p15). R1, R2 tolerance <= +/-5%.

pins.name: NC
pins.notes: Must be left floating with no external connection.

pins.name: SCL
pins.notes: Serial clock for the I2C interface; thresholds referenced to DVDD (p5). Pull-up not stated in the datasheet text; I2C open-drain bus convention.

pins.name: SDA
pins.notes: Serial data input or output for the I2C interface; thresholds referenced to DVDD (p5). Pull-up not stated in the datasheet text; I2C open-drain bus convention.

pins.name: Thermal pad
pins.notes: Exposed thermal pad; connect to GND. Number 17 from the package drawing (p36); the pin table lists no number.

external_components.role: AVDD decoupling capacitor (1 uF low-ESR ceramic recommended, 200 nF minimum)
DVDD decoupling capacitor (1 uF ceramic recommended, 20 nF minimum)
ADDR resistor R1 (optional, from DECAP): 0 ohm, 11k, 33k or 100k selects 0x17/0x16/0x15/0x14; tolerance <= 5%
ADDR resistor R2 (optional, to GND): 11k, 33k or 100k selects 0x11/0x12/0x13; tolerance <= 5%; R1 and R2 both DNP gives 0x10
Pull-up resistor on a GPIO configured as open-drain output: VPULL_UP / 5 mA < RPULL_UP < VPULL_UP / ILOAD

layout_notes.text: Avoid crossing digital lines with the analog signal path; keep the analog input signals and the AVDD supply away from noise sources.
Use 1 uF ceramic bypass capacitors in close proximity to AVDD and DVDD; avoid vias between the AVDD/DVDD pins and their bypass capacitors.
Connect GND to the ground plane using short, low-impedance paths.
AVDD is the ADC reference: place its decoupling capacitor close to the AVDD and GND pins and connect it with thick copper tracks.
Decouple AVDD and DVDD individually with 1 uF; if both supplies come from the same source, 220 nF minimum. AVDD and DVDD may be shorted externally for single supply above 2.35 V.
Solder the exposed thermal pad to the PCB; vias under the paste should be filled, plugged or tented.

gaps: No DVDD supply current (IDVDD) in the Electrical Characteristics; only IAVDD (p5).
DNL, INL, offset and gain error are typical only; no guaranteed min/max limits (p5). The ADS7128 datasheet is the guaranteed-limit sister part.
Electrical Characteristics are stated for AVDD = 2.35 V to 5 V, not up to 5.5 V (p5).
I2C IOL (3/6/20 mA) and GPIO IOH/IOL (5 mA) are printed in the MAX column of Table 6.5 (p5); whether they are guaranteed sink capability (min) is not stated.
AINx/GPIOx absolute max and absolute input range are relative to AVDD (AVDD + 0.3 V, AVDD + 0.1 V); recorded as offsets because the schema needs numbers (p4).
No GPIO pull-up, pull-down or default output state beyond: all channels are analog inputs at power-up or reset (p13).
No I2C pull-up resistor value or requirement stated for SDA/SCL; pull_up requirement set by I2C bus convention, not by a datasheet sentence.
No input RC filter recommendation for the analog inputs; only RSW 150 ohm typ, CSH 12 pF typ (p13) and tACQ 300 ns min (p6).
tCONV is given only as equal to tSTRETCH (p7); no separate number.

Open-drain GPIO pull-up rule (p31) is a range rule, not a Python equation with part-value variables; not entered under equations. The ADC LSB equation 1 LSB = AVDD / 2^12 (p13) has no part-value variable and is not entered.
Thermal pad number 17 taken from the package drawing (p36), not from the pin table (p3).
